method: Campaign planning estimates, not recovered musters. Personnel gross flows continue each jurisdiction’s previously documented 431-day average for the remaining 59 days; they are not population multipliers. Equipment programmes continue their own recorded delivery/repair and withdrawal rates for 80 days. Categories without a net programme receive balanced maintenance turnover (annual aircraft 8%, armour 4%, artillery 2.5%, fleet tonnage 1.5%). Fleet figures are serviceable tonnes, not invented new ship counts. Field capacity retains its constrained share of serving strength. These are explicit neutral carry-forward assumptions with the prior approximately 15% personnel uncertainty, wider for fragmented returns. New events replace assumptions, rather than adding duplicate flows.
accounting: Ordinary turnover, maintenance and procurement remain within existing national budget envelopes and demographic mortality. Other departures are not all deaths. No general mobilisation, new invasion, exceptional casualty event, technology unlock or new rifle batch is invented. Historical Year 68 development files and prior returns remain untouched.
